title: anthropic-version 2026-10-21 rejects temperature, top_p and top_k with 400
summary: API version 2026-10-21 (released 2026-10-21 and sent by default by the new major SDK versions) removes temperature, top_p and top_k from the Messages API: any request that sends one of them returns 400, even at the default value. The same version also returns 400 for document blocks in assistant messages and for citations on user text blocks. Requests that stay on 2023-06-01 are unchanged.
migrationNote: Before sending anthropic-version: 2026-10-21 or upgrading to the new SDK majors (Python 2.0.0, TypeScript 1.0.0, Go 2.0.0, Java 3.0.0, Ruby 2.0.0, PHP 1.0.0, C# 13.0.0), remove temperature, top_p and top_k from Messages, token-counting and batch requests, move document blocks into user messages, and drop citations from user text blocks. If a request depends on a non-default temperature, keep that request on 2023-06-01.

provenance.quote: Affects you if you send temperature, top_p, or top_k in Messages requests or Message Batch requests.
The temperature, top_p, and top_k request parameters are removed. A request that sends any of them returns a 400 error on every model.
Setting the sampling parameters temperature, top_p, or top_k to a non-default value returns a 400 error on Claude Opus 4.8, same as on Claude Opus 4.7. See the migration guide for details.
